scope: BPI Phase 1 shadow-batch vertical slice only

items.operation: Reject candidate evidence without eventTime before persistence
items.evidence: Bean validation rejected the malformed evidence and the tenant inbox count remained zero.

items.operation: Ingest a batch candidate with a real signed internal JWT
items.evidence: Candidate persisted as PENDING at revision 1 under JWT tenant, plant and line claims.
The replay returned the same candidate ID; candidate and inbox counts remained one.

items.operation: Reuse the eventId with a different candidateKey and changed payload checksum
items.evidence: application/problem+json conflict returned with a traceId; no additional inbox or candidate row persisted.

items.operation: Confirm a candidate without Idempotency-Key and If-Match
items.evidence: The command was rejected before persistence.

items.operation: Confirm a candidate and create an audited shadow batch
items.evidence: Candidate became CONFIRMED at revision 2; batch was shadow=true and wmsStatus=NOT_REQUESTED.

items.operation: Replay the confirmation command with the same idempotency key
items.evidence: Idempotent-Replay=true and the original batch ID were returned without duplicate persistence.

items.operation: Replay a completed idempotent command with a token that no longer covers the candidate line
items.evidence: Object scope was rechecked before the cached idempotent response could be returned.

items.operation: Confirm with a new idempotency key and stale If-Match revision
items.evidence: currentRevision=2 was returned; the transaction rolled back and did not persist an additional idempotency row.

items.operation: Read the shadow batch, boundary evidence and state timeline
items.evidence: The response contained shadow=true, one start evidence item and SHADOW_BATCH_CREATED in the timeline.

items.operation: Read a candidate with the same tenant but an unauthorized line claim
Read a candidate with a different tenant claim
items.evidence: Cross-tenant access returned not found and did not disclose object existence.

items.operation: Run a command after removing the tenant line override for bpi.commands
items.evidence: The request inherited the global bpi.commands=false flag and was denied before command persistence.

persistenceVerification.idempotencyCountNote: The actual test assertion is 1, not 2. The successful command and same-key replay share one row; the stale-revision command uses a new key but its transaction rolls back on 409, so it leaves no persistent row.
persistenceVerification.cleanup: After each test, targeted DELETE statements remove only rows belonging to the dynamic tenant marker, including the seeded rule and topology versions.

limitations: This is only the BPI Phase 1 shadow-batch vertical slice and is not a full Phase 1 production acceptance.
Kafka transport, partitioning, backlog recovery and consumer replay were not tested.
Flink event-time processing, watermarks, late events and state recovery were not tested.
The candidate payload came from an acceptance replay and not from a real IoT or JetLinks source.
No browser UI flow was exercised.
No WOM, QCS or WMS write was executed; wmsStatus=NOT_REQUESTED is expected for this slice.
Acceptance JWTs use a short-lived HS256 internal test secret; production JWKS/asymmetric signing and key rotation remain pending.
Docker Compose rendered successfully, but the local Docker daemon was unavailable for container runtime acceptance.
Production deployment, concurrency load, fault injection, backup restore and soak testing remain out of scope.
